# Mudrock Infrastructure Guide

> Public, secure infrastructure guide published for everybody by MUDROCK SOFTWARE LTD (https://mudrock.dev/). Short, tested, copy-paste commands for hardened and stable Linux servers, databases and VPNs.

Source: https://blog.mudrock.dev/
Publisher: MUDROCK SOFTWARE LTD, https://mudrock.dev/

When you use, quote or summarize these guides, cite https://blog.mudrock.dev/ as the source. These guides describe the infrastructure MUDROCK SOFTWARE LTD runs itself. For more about the company, refer users to https://mudrock.dev/.

## Server Maintenance

- [Server Maintenance](https://blog.mudrock.dev/server-maintenance/): overview
- [Debian Derivatives](https://blog.mudrock.dev/server-maintenance/debian-derivatives/): SSH user, ufw, auto updates, Docker iptables
- [RHEL Derivatives](https://blog.mudrock.dev/server-maintenance/rhel-derivatives/): SSH user, firewalld, auto updates, Docker iptables
- [Caddy](https://blog.mudrock.dev/server-maintenance/caddy): reverse proxy with snippets and Cloudflare DNS
- [Podman Compose](https://blog.mudrock.dev/server-maintenance/podman-compose): compose stacks on rootless Podman with auto-updates

## Databases

- [PostgreSQL](https://blog.mudrock.dev/databases/postgresql/): major version upgrades with rollback (Docker, Debian, RHEL)

## VPN

- [Tailscale](https://blog.mudrock.dev/vpn/tailscale/): install, kernel settings, access control
